test_title: PYST 20: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

__When I bought__ the book, I __thought __it __will__ be interesting.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the future tense 'will' is incorrect.
 
• In the given sentence, the action of buying the book happened in the** past,** so the verb should be in the **past tense.**
 
• The correct verb form should be 'would' to match the past tense context of the sentence.
 
• Therefore, the verb 'will' should be replaced with 'would'.

Hence, the correct sentence is '***When I bought the book, I thought it would __be interesting*.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The other parts of the sentence are correct having no grammatical error.
 
• If the **action in the main clause** is in the past tense, the verb in the **dependent clause** should also be in a **past tense form.**
 
• For example, in sentences like ***"She said that she would come."*** the main clause "**She said"** is in past tense, so the verb in the dependent clause "**would** **come" i**s also in a form that reflects** past tense.**
